citation.note: Employee records retention: Personnel files must be retained 5 years post-separation (state agency standard); federal FLSA requires 3 years for payroll records.

Semi-monthly pay required for corporate employers; corporations with $500k+ annual income may pay exempt management monthly; non-corporate employers must keep a consistent schedule (Ark. Code § 11-4-401).
Final paycheck due within 7 days of discharge on employee demand, otherwise by the next regular payday; double-wage penalty for late payment (Ark. Code § 11-4-405).

citation.note: Minimum wage $11.00/hour for employers with 4+ employees; overtime 1.5x for actual hours over 40/week; the higher of state or federal controls (Ark. Code § 11-4-211).

Sex-based wage discrimination prohibited for employers of any size; differentials allowed for seniority, experience, training, skill, ability, duties, shift, or other reasonable differentiation (Ark. Code § 11-4-405).
